notes.title: Sequel Annoucement + Experiment 3 Avaliable Now
notes.content:
[h1]Second Thoughts: Terminal[/h1]

[h3]A sequel is being developed for Second Thoughts, be sure to wishlist it today![/h3]

This sequel will feature a lot more of an in-depth look into the mysterious organization and systems that you perform the experiments on. With a total of [b]over two hundred different subjects[/b] to go through over the course of the entire game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755340

[h1]+ A New Experiment[/h1]

[h3]"Experiment 3: Lifeline" is free to play and available now![/h3]

To go along with the announcement of the sequel, a new experiment has been added to the game to connect the start of the next game with this one. Hope you enjoy it!

[list]
[*] Just like with the first experiment, here you will be required to execute a subject each day.
[*] This time none of the subjects have listed crimes in their general information.
[*] New types of information, unlike the first two experiments, will be provided.
[*] You will be required to finish the first two experiments to gain access to this one.
[/list]

notes.title: Second Thoughts Version 1.1 Update | Experiment 2: Tartarus
notes.content:
[h1][b]Experiment 2: Tartarus[/b][/h1]

[b]- Added Experiment 2: Tartarus.[/b]
[list]
[*] This time, you are tasked with releasing seven subjects and leaving one to be executed.
[*] Each subject has committed crimes a lot more severe than that of the first experiment.
[*] The type and order of information you will receive will also differ from the first experiment.
[*] You can access the new experiment after you have completed the first one.
[/list]
[h1][b]Added Features:[/b][/h1]
	
- Added additional functionality to observation to display the status of each subject every day.
- Added ability to go back to the main menu from an experiment, rather than just closing the game.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]

- Fixed some timings between several menus to make the game flow better.
- Fixed some spelling and grammar mistakes in experiment 1.
- Fixed bug where volume would reset when returning to the main menu from an experiment.
- Fixed bug where you could access the execute screen on experiment 1 after finishing.
- Fixed bug where the arrow would be in the wrong place after returning to subject list using ESC.
- Fixed bug in observation where specific subjects wouldn't appear properly.
- Fixed volume of splash screen being too loud.
- Fixed volume of execution sound in experiment 1 being too loud.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
- Added a post game so that you can view the data on all the subjects after making your final choice.
- Made it clear that you can press ESC to return to subject list.
- Decreased time between specific transitions to keep the flow of the game moving.
- Changed game ending to go to post game view rather than closing the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
- WASD can now be used as well as arrow keys to navigate.
- Fixed word error in one of the entry's.
- Removed Z and X being used for navigation to prevent accidental inputs.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
- Changed some of the dialogue so it reads better.
- Fixed multiple grammatical errors throughout the game.
- Fixed multiple spelling mistakes throughout the game.
- Fixed a name display error.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content: - Decreased wait times between most screens (specifically info screens) for a smoother experience.
